run_dump_hubert_feature_s2t_cli: run the CLI to dump HuBERT features from speech-to-text zip archives using a checkpoint and TSV manifest
run_dump_feature_function: run the dump_feature function to extract HuBERT features from audio paths listed in a TSV file
create_HubertFeatureReaderS2T_class: create a HubertFeatureReaderS2T subclass that reads audio from uncompressed zip archives using offset and size metadata
run_get_path_iterator: run get_path_iterator to shard a TSV manifest into per-rank audio path iterators for distributed feature extraction
review_HubertFeatureReaderS2T_read_audio: review the read_audio method that extracts waveforms from zip archives and normalizes stereo to mono
